title: Overview of the Machine Learning services in AWS

cues.en: Hello, my friends, and welcome to this new tutorial on this overview of the other machinery models.
cues.zh: 朋友們好，歡迎來到其他機器學習服務概觀。

cues.en: We already used a lot of SageMaker not only to do data preparation, but also to develop models.
cues.zh: 已大量使用 SageMaker，做資料準備與模型開發。

cues.en: And, of course, we'll do more in the next section to deploy our machine learning models.
cues.zh: 下一節當然會繼續部署模型。

cues.en: But, for now, in this section on model development, I wanna show you all the other machine learning services that you have in AWS, because some questions on any of them
cues.zh: 目前模型開發章節，想展示 AWS 其他全部機器學習服務，因為任何一個

cues.en: can come up at the exam.
cues.zh: 都可能出考題。

cues.en: And so I'm just gonna show all of them to you, read out loud the little description for each of them so that at least you get in your head the information of what they are in order for you
cues.zh: 會逐個展示，朗讀簡短介紹，讓你記住用途，

cues.en: to answer the exam questions correctly in case they come up.
cues.zh: 遇到考題就能答對。

cues.en: Okay, so here we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: In order to find the machine learning category of AWS, you click these square dots here.
cues.zh: 要找 AWS 機器學習類別，按這些方形點。

cues.en: And then, if you scroll down, you will find the machine learning category of AWS, which will give you all the machine learning services.
cues.zh: 往下捲，找到 Machine Learning，就有全部服務。

cues.en: Here they are.
cues.zh: 在這裡。

cues.en: And so that's what I'm gonna do, I'm gonna go through all of them now, read the quick description here and tell you, at the same time, which of these services will be covered in a brief demo
cues.zh: 現在逐個看、讀簡述，也會指出接下來哪些有簡短示範，

cues.en: in the upcoming tutorials.
cues.zh: 在後續教學裡。

cues.en: Okay, so here we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: First, you have Amazon Augmented AI, with which you can easily implement human review of machine learning predictions.
cues.zh: Amazon Augmented AI，輕鬆為機器學習預測加入人工審查。

cues.en: Then, you have Amazon Bedrock, that's the service for generative AI and agent AI.
cues.zh: Amazon Bedrock，用於生成式 AI 與智能體 AI。

cues.en: It's indeed the easiest way to build and scale generative AI applications with foundation models, and, of course, Amazon Bedrock will be covered.
cues.zh: 透過基礎模型建立、擴展生成式 AI 應用的簡單方式，當然會介紹。

cues.en: Then, you have Amazon Bedrock Agent Core with which you can deploy and operate highly effective agents securely at scale using any framework and model.
cues.zh: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore，可用任何框架、模型，安全且大規模部署、操作高效智能體。

cues.en: Then, you have Amazon CodeGuru, which can provide intelligent recommendations for building and running modern applications.
cues.zh: Amazon CodeGuru，提供建立、執行現代應用的智慧建議。

cues.en: Then, you have Amazon Comprehend, that's the AWS service for NLP, natural language processing, with which you can analyze unstructured text.
cues.zh: Amazon Comprehend，AWS 的 NLP 自然語言處理服務，分析非結構化文字。

cues.en: And we will do a demo of Amazon Comprehend.
cues.zh: 會做示範。

cues.en: Then, you have Amazon Comprehend Medical, which uses machine learning to extract insights and relationships from medical text, okay?
cues.zh: Amazon Comprehend Medical，用機器學習從醫療文字擷取洞見與關係。

cues.en: That's the essential thing to remember here.
cues.zh: 記住重點。

cues.en: Then, you have AWS DeepRacer with which you can do deep reinforcement learning to train a self-driving car, a fully autonomous, 1/18th scale race car
cues.zh: AWS DeepRacer，用深度強化學習訓練自駕車，是全自動、1/18 比例賽車，

cues.en: driven by machine learning, more precisely deep reinforcement learning.
cues.zh: 由機器學習，更確切說深度強化學習驅動。

cues.en: Then, you have Amazon DevOps Guru, which is an ML-powered cloud operation service that you can use to improve application availability.
cues.zh: Amazon DevOps Guru，機器學習驅動的雲端維運服務，改善應用可用性。

cues.en: Then, you have Amazon Forecast, a fully managed service for accurate time series forecasting, so that's for time series analysis.
cues.zh: Amazon Forecast，全受管的準確時間序列預測服務，用於時間序列分析。

cues.en: Then, Amazon Fraud Detector with which, of course, you can detect more online fraud faster using machine learning.
cues.zh: Amazon Fraud Detector，利用機器學習更快偵測更多線上詐欺。

cues.en: Then, you have AWS HealthImaging that you can use to store, analyze, and share medical images.
cues.zh: AWS HealthImaging，儲存、分析、分享醫療影像。

cues.en: Then, you have AWS HealthLake that you can use to analyze and derive insights from health data.
cues.zh: AWS HealthLake，分析健康資料並取得洞見。

cues.en: Then, you have AWS HealthOmics, which you can use to transform omics data into insights.
cues.zh: AWS HealthOmics，將體學資料轉為洞見。

cues.en: Then, you have Amazon Kendra, which is a highly accurate enterprise search service powered by machine learning.
cues.zh: Amazon Kendra，機器學習驅動的高準確度企業搜尋。

cues.en: You can actually see it as the Google for Enterprises.
cues.zh: 可看成企業 Google。

cues.en: Then, you have Amazon Lex, basically the chatbot service of AWS that allows you to build, voice, and text chatbots.
cues.zh: Amazon Lex，AWS 聊天機器人服務，建立語音與文字機器人。

cues.en: Then, you have, let's scroll down more, Amazon Lookout for Equipment with which you can detect abnormal equipment behavior by analyzing sensor data.
cues.zh: 往下，Amazon Lookout for Equipment，分析感測器資料，偵測設備異常行為。

cues.en: Then, you have Amazon Lookout for Metrics, so pay attention to the difference between the two, okay?
cues.zh: Amazon Lookout for Metrics，注意差別。

cues.en: Amazon Lookout for Metrics accurately detects anomalies in your business metrics and quickly understands why.
cues.zh: 它準確偵測業務指標異常，快速理解原因。

cues.en: And then, the third Lookout, Amazon Lookout for Vision, which identifies defects using computer vision to automate quality inspection, okay?
cues.zh: 第三個 Lookout for Vision，用電腦視覺找缺陷，自動化品質檢查。

cues.en: So important to remember that you might have some questions on the Lookout services in the exam, so just remember this.
cues.zh: 考試可能問 Lookout 服務，記住。

cues.en: Then, Amazon Monitron, which is an end-to-end system for equipment monitoring.
cues.zh: Amazon Monitron，端到端設備監控系統。

cues.en: Then, AWS Panorama, which allows you to enable computer vision applications at the edge.
cues.zh: AWS Panorama，讓邊緣裝置能執行電腦視覺應用。

cues.en: Then, Amazon Personalize, with which can build recommended systems.
cues.zh: Amazon Personalize，建立推薦系統。

cues.en: Indeed, Amazon Personalize helps you easily add realtime recommendations to your apps.
cues.zh: 輕鬆把即時推薦加到應用。

cues.en: And we have an amazing lab on Amazon Personalize, if you wanna dive deeper into it.
cues.zh: 有很棒的實驗，想深入可以看。

cues.en: Amazon Polly, which turns text into lifelike speech, and we will do a demo of Polly in the same section.
cues.zh: Amazon Polly，把文字變逼真語音，本節會示範。

cues.en: Then, you have Amazon Q.
cues.zh: 再來 Amazon Q。

cues.en: There we go, we are reaching the end, good.
cues.zh: 快到最後，很好。

cues.en: So Amazon Q is a generative AI-powered assistant from AWS to help reinvent how you work.
cues.zh: Amazon Q 是 AWS 生成式 AI 助理，協助重新設計工作方式。

cues.en: Amazon Q Business, which is a generative AI-powered enterprise assistant.
cues.zh: Amazon Q Business，生成式 AI 企業助理。

cues.en: Then, Amazon Rekognition, the AWS service for computer vision, which we will do a demo on, and that you can use to search and analyze images, more precisely, do object detection or feature recognition
cues.zh: Amazon Rekognition，AWS 電腦視覺服務，會示範。可搜尋、分析影像，更具體說偵測物件、辨識特徵，

cues.en: inside images or even videos.
cues.zh: 也支援影片。

cues.en: Then, Amazon SageMaker AI, well, of course, it's the main machine learning service with which can build, train, and deploy machine learning models.
cues.zh: Amazon SageMaker AI，當然是主要機器學習服務，建立、訓練、部署模型。

cues.en: And, in the next section, we'll cover the deployment parts.
cues.zh: 下一節介紹部署。

cues.en: Then, you have Amazon Textract, which easily extracts text and data from virtually any document.
cues.zh: Amazon Textract，從幾乎任何文件擷取文字與資料。

cues.en: And we will do a demo of that service in the next tutorial.
cues.zh: 下一堂會示範。

cues.en: Then, you have Amazon Transcribe, which is a powerful speech recognition service that you can use to turn audio into text basically.
cues.zh: Amazon Transcribe，強大語音辨識服務，基本上把音訊轉文字。

cues.en: And, finally, Amazon Translate, super easy one, which is, of course, a powerful neural machine translation.
cues.zh: 最後 Amazon Translate，很簡單，就是強大的神經機器翻譯。

cues.en: Okay, so there we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: These are all the AWS services in the machine learning category.
cues.zh: 以上是 Machine Learning 類別的 AWS 服務。

cues.en: It's very important to at least remember simply what each one does because, again, some questions on them might come up at the exam, okay?
cues.zh: 至少簡單記得各自做什麼，很重要，因為可能考。

cues.en: So that's it for this overview of all the machine learning services of AWS.
cues.zh: 概觀到此。

cues.en: Now, I can't wait to start the demos with you.
cues.zh: 迫不及待一起開始示範。

cues.en: And, until then, enjoy machine learning with AWS.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受 AWS 機器學習的樂趣吧。
